input.analyst: Observed strong mixes (mix-370, mix-401) have water/binder near 0.26 to 0.28 with high cement or cement plus slag, and weak mixes (mix-095) have low cement with high fly ash and water, so the top-ranked low-ratio menu mixes look most promising, though the model estimates carry RF tree SD of about 6 to 13 MPa.
